svg.aria-label: First duck hunt timeline. Night before: check sunrise, legal start and wind, pack. Arrive 1 hour before legal light and set 6 to 12 decoys by flashlight. Hide with the wind at your side or back, guns unloaded until set. Legal start, half an hour before sunrise: shoot your own side when ducks commit. Fetch each bird. Done by about 10 o'clock or at your bag: pick up every decoy and shell.

g.text: wind at side or back, guns unloaded
ducks commit, call it, your side
fetch each bird, count by species
pick up decoys and every shell
